title: Text Area
description: Public API, multiline editing, line bounds, synchronisation, accessibility, and native platform behaviour for Firstlight Text Area.

blocks.text:
Text Area enters and edits plain multiline text using each platform's native
selection, composition, focus, scrolling, autocapitalization, and autocorrection
behaviour.

<firstlight:text-area
    label="Clinical notes"
    placeholder="Add relevant history and observations"
    helper="Do not include information that is not required."
    :required="true"
    :min-lines="4"
    :max-lines="10"
    autocapitalize="sentences"
    native:model.debounce.500ms="notes"
/>

blocks.label: value / native:model
blocks.text:
Accepted type: string
Purpose: Published PHP value; omission defaults to ''.

blocks.label: label
blocks.text:
Accepted type: string
Purpose: Visible label and accessibility-name fallback.

blocks.label: placeholder
blocks.text:
Accepted type: string
Purpose: Short empty-state guidance; never replaces a label.

blocks.label: helper
blocks.text:
Accepted type: string
Purpose: Supporting guidance below the field.

blocks.label: error
blocks.text:
Accepted type: string
Purpose: Validation feedback that replaces helper text.

blocks.label: required
blocks.text:
Accepted type: bool
Purpose: Communicates required metadata without performing validation.

blocks.label: disabled
blocks.text:
Accepted type: bool
Purpose: Prevents focus and editing.

blocks.label: read-only
blocks.text:
Accepted type: bool
Purpose: Keeps native selection, copy, and scrolling while preventing edits.

blocks.label: min-lines
blocks.text:
Accepted type: positive int
Purpose: Minimum visible lines; defaults to 3.

blocks.label: max-lines
blocks.text:
Accepted type: positive int
Purpose: Maximum visible lines before native scrolling; defaults to 8.

blocks.label: autocapitalize
blocks.text:
Accepted type: enum string
Purpose: none, sentences, words, or characters; omission keeps platform policy.

blocks.label: autocorrect
blocks.text:
Accepted type: bool
Purpose: Explicitly enables or disables platform autocorrection.

blocks.label: a11y-label
blocks.text:
Accepted type: string
Purpose: Explicit accessible name when no visible label is appropriate.

blocks.label: a11y-hint
blocks.text:
Accepted type: string
Purpose: Additional VoiceOver or TalkBack guidance.

blocks.label: class
blocks.text:
Accepted type: string
Purpose: External EDGE layout for the complete field.

max-lines must be greater than or equal to min-lines. Public Blade examples
use kebab-case. The PHP element also accepts minLines, maxLines, and
readOnly aliases.

@change receives the complete current string, including newline characters.
Plain native:model and .live publish while editing. .blur and .lazy
publish on focus loss. .debounce.500ms publishes after the quiet period and
flushes on blur. Durations below 50 milliseconds are rejected.

On iOS, pressing a <firstlight:button> while the editor is focused publishes
its pending .blur or .debounce change before the press, so the handler reads
the current value. Icon Button and List Item presses do not flush the editor
first. On Android, blur/debounce changes are not yet guaranteed to reach PHP
before a button press, so for forms submitted by a separate button use
native:model.live="notes" (or plain native:model). Keyboard dismissal alone
is not an ordering guarantee there.

Typing, selection, cursor position, marked text or IME composition, focus,
keyboard, and scroll position remain native while focused. PHP acknowledgements
therefore do not replace the active buffer. Different server publications wait
for safe reconciliation, while unfocused programmatic updates replace the
displayed string without emitting @change.

Text Area intentionally has no @submit, @press, icons, secure mode,
single-line keyboard or content hints, clear/reveal affordances, loading state,
prefix, suffix, or styling escape props.

Contract exceptions still reject invalid types, unordered line bounds, and
unsupported sync modes before publication. User validation is separate:
screens that use ValidatesFields auto-bind the first MessageBag message for
the field's native:model or error-for name. An authored error wins.
required is display metadata and does not run Laravel rules. See
Validate fields.

A visible label or explicit a11y-label is required during development.
Error text replaces helper text while preserving the current accessible name
and value. Disabled and read-only states remain distinct. Native type scaling,
light and dark appearance, increased contrast, Reduced Motion, and RTL remain
platform-owned.

iOS uses a genuine SwiftUI TextEditor in Apple-native field composition.
Android uses Material 3 OutlinedTextField with TextFieldValue, multiline
line bounds, supporting and error slots, and Compose selection and composition.
